paite: Paul leh Timothi, Khrist Jesu sikhate'n, Philippi a om misiangthou tengteng leh heutute leh upate kiang ah:
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Hehpihna leh khamuanna i Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan na tung uah om hen.
Noute ka hon theihgigena ah ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi,
heading: Paul Kipahthu Genna

paite: na vek ua ding a kipaktak a thum a ka hon ngetsakna teng ah;
ani masapen a pan tuni tanpha a tanchinhoih a na kithuahkhawmna ziak ua kipak in.
Hiai thil mahmah gingta ing; amah nou a nasep hoih panpa'n Jesu ni tanpha in azoukim vek ding hi.
Na vek ua tungtang thu a, ke'n hichibang lungsim ka neih adik ahi, ka lungtang a ka hon neih ziak in; ka kolbutna leh tanchinhoih gupna leh hihkipna thu a hehpihna ka tanpihte na hi vek uhi.
Khrist Jesu hehpihna nou ngiingei ah nou ka hon ngai mahmah chih Pathian in ahon theihpih hi.
Noute theihna leh theihkakna toh kithuah itna a na khan semsemna ding un ka thum hi.
Huchi a thil hoihpen na deih ua, Khrist ni a siangthou leh dembei a na omtheihna ding uh leh,
Pathian thupina leh pahtawina ding a, Jesu Khrist ziak a hong om dikna gahte na dimtheihna ding un.
Unaute aw, tu in ka tung a thil hong tungte, tanchinhoih akhanna dia hong tung ahi uh chih na theih uh ka deih;
heading: Paul Suangkul Tanna Ziakte

paite: huchi in inpi vengpawl tengteng leh adang tengteng kiang ah Khrist ziak a kolbun ka hi chih achiangta hi.
Ka kolbuhna a kipan a Toupa muanna nei in unaute lak a tampite lau lou a Pathian thu gen ding in nakpitak in ahong hangsan deuhdeuhta uhi.
Khenkhatte'n hazatna ziak leh thangpaihna ziak in Khrist atangkoupih ua; khenkhatte'n hoih asak ziak un agen uh.
Pawl khatte'n itna ziak in, tanchinhoih dikdan gen dia om ka hihdan thei in agen uhi.
Himahleh pawl dang in kikhenna ding in Khrist atangkoupih ua, ataktak hilou in ka kolbuhna a ka thuakna behlap tum in.
Bang apoi a? Kong bangkim a Khrist akigenkhiak photleh akhem hi in atak hitaleh, huai ah ka kipak hi. Ahi, ka kipak zel lai ding hi.
Na thumnate uh leh Jesu Khrist Kha panpihna ziak in hiai ka suahtakna hong suak ding chih ka thei hi.
heading: Khrist A Hinna Leh Sihna

paite: Ka gintak taktakna leh ka lametna bang in bangmah ah hihzum in ka om kei hial dia, himahleh ahi gige sa mah bang in tu in leng ka hinna hiam ka sihna hiam in ka pumpi ah hangsanna kim toh Khrist hihlet in a-om ngeingei ding hi.
Kei a ding in zaw hin Khrist ahi a, huan sih leng punna ahi.
Himahleh sa a hin ka tan ding hitaleh kei a ding in sepgim gah tampi suahna ding ahi. Hinapi in ka tel ding pen ka thei kei.
Nih kalteh in hamhaihtak in ka om hi. Paimang a Khrist kiang a om utna ka nei a; huai lah nakpitak in ahoihzaw ngal a.
Himahleh noute ziak in sa a om phot akiphamohzaw hi.
Huchi in hiai ginna ka neih ziak in, ka om phot ding chih ka thei; ginna a na khanletna ding uh leh na kipahna ding un, na vek ua lak ah ka om phot ding hi;
huchi a na kiang ua ka hong pai nawn ding ziak a Khrist Jesu na suanna ding uh tam semsem kei a na neihna ding un.

Na omdan uh Khrist tanchinhoih toh kituaksak photphot un; hong hoh a, nou hong muh hiam, ahihkeileh ka om louh a leng kha khat a na dinkipdan uh leh lungsim khat nei a tanchinhoih thugin a na pandan uh, na tanchin uh ka zaktheihna ding in.
Huan bangmah ah na melmate uh hihlau in om kei un. Huai amau a ding in manna ding kichetna teltak ahi a, himahleh nou a ding in hotdamna ding kichetna ahi, huai Pathian a kipan ahi.
Hiai tuh noute a ding in phal ahita; Khrist gingtate kia hilou in, ama ziak in na thuak sam ding uh.
Keimah a na muh uleh na zak uh huai kidouna mah na dou ding uh ahi.
